t: Innovative Performance Chip | EcoDieselRam.com - EcoDiesel Ram 1500 Truck Community
s: June 24, 2024 - Has any one else tried one of these, I installed about 1 month ago , i have been checking fuel milage hand calculated and have seen a 2-3 mpg gain , i also think it may have a little better performance , seems smoother. ... How 'bout a link please. ... Update on innovative chip, I originally found this on my facebook feed and ordered it before checking it out , I did remove it after finding out how it works, what it does using resistors is make the engine temperature cold all the time so it runs richer , it taps into The wiring at the mass airflow sensor at the air cleaner box, after more testing on the mileage it doesn’t make much difference, I checked on a 800 mile trip and I guess it was wishful thinking to start with , I would not recommend it to any one, it may cause unforeseen damage to the ECM I think the best answer for me will probably be the Banks Darenger.
